shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab/stele
a disc or round element in the upper field
horizontal register bands dividing the field
repeated rows of small motifs filling the surface
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief imagery organised into a figured scene above and a dense field of repeated small signs/motifs below, with a rounded disc-like element in the upper zone and profile figures with outstretched limbs. But the content differs fundamentally: A shows human figures with a rayed disc above an offering table over columns of writing-like signs, while B shows a row of repeated U-shaped/hooded forms above a zigzag band with predatory quadrupeds, a large bird and a snake-like creature, all rendered in bold rounded relief rather than fine incised outline.
